adapters.exportDuty: Leaves with us: auth.users (ids, emails, identities) by pg_dump of the auth schema; the ids are the foreign key every row we own carries, so they must move unchanged. Cannot move: password hashes outside a GoTrue-compatible target, and live sessions — every user signs in again after a cutover.
Nothing leaves: the fake holds its users in memory for the life of the process and has no record to export.

_why: L2: the app reads AuthRepository only, and the composition root (authRepositoryProvider) picks SupabaseAuthRepository or the in-memory fake from AppConfig.isBackendLive; C-5 (assert-package-boundaries.mjs) already refuses an app importing the Supabase SDK around the seam.

The Supabase URL and anon key are public build configuration (dart-defines classified build-config in tooling/channel-register.json), not secrets, so `secrets` is empty. The Worker-side JWT verification is not this port.

Box C (self-hosted GoTrue) is the planned second adapter; it is the same Supabase client against another origin, so it arrives as an `external` row with its configAt and verify (tooling/ops/auth-cutover-preflight.mjs), not as new code.
